tips.text: Dragonkin breathe fire; avoid the front of drakes and keep cooldowns for the Eranikus shade.

tips.text: Pick up the Atal'ai Haunts and class quest items as you go; most quests finish on the bottom floor.

sources.label: Wowhead Classic: Sunken Temple (Temple of Atal'Hakkar)

tips.text: Run the Sunken Temple once. Do not reset for a second Morphaz.
At most five dungeon entries/resets per hour. Kill XP inside dungeons is increased by 50%. If any party member would get no XP because the mobs are trivial to them, nobody in the party gets XP.
